about.description:
GPCI is the vault share token for Goblin
  Private Credit I, a permissioned USDC yield product on Pharos Mainnet.
  Depositors mint GPCI in exchange for USDC deposited into a smart-contract
  vault that funds a single institutional borrower under a private credit
  facility approximately 3 months in duration. The offering targets
  institutional-grade yield sourced from vetted private credit positions. Both
  minting and holding require KYC and allowlisting. Settlement is coordinated
  through the Ember Protocol tokenization rail, with contracts audited by
  Movebit and Plainshift.
about.registryInfo:
Goblin Issuer Inc is the token-issuing
  entity for the Goblin Finance private credit product suite. Public
  jurisdiction and formal registration were not surfaced in disclosed
  materials. GPCI is deployed on the Pharos Mainnet as a permissioned ERC-20
  with USDC as the underlying deposit asset and settlement is coordinated
  through the Ember Protocol tokenization rail. Ember and Goblin ALM smart
  contracts have been audited by Movebit and Plainshift.
